Hello! I'm Preston Yang.

I'm a Mechanical Engineering student at NYU who enjoys working on every aspect of a project, from analyzing the problem to designing, manufacturing, and testing. For me, every stage has taught and changed how I understand the other, like how early design choices can become a manufacturing constraint or how, while testing, you discover an issue that sets you back to nothing.

As for engineering interests, I hope to be part of the future of deployable space systems, in-space manufacturing, and drone/UAVs. However, no matter what I am working on, I do not want to simply say I was part of the project. I want the effort I put in to be reflected in the quality of my results and in how effectively the team moves forward.

Outside of engineering I like to hike, take photos, go to flea markets, cook AND eat food, all of which give me a different way to slow down.
